mapper.select: SELECT 1 AS id, '月报' AS reportType, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AS reportTime, (SELECT MIN(create_time) FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0) AS startTime, (SELECT MAX(create_time) FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0) AS endTime, 'system' AS creator, NOW() AS createTime

SELECT 1 AS id, #{query.reportType} AS reportType, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AS reportTime, #{query.startTime} AS startTime, #{query.endTime} AS endTime, 'system' AS creator, NOW() AS createTime,
-- 指标都来自独立子查询，绝不关联，绝不重复 IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0), 0) AS station_count, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(space_total) FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0), 0) AS total_space_count, IFNULL(( SELECT ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN real_status = '占用' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2 ) FROM parking_space_info WHERE deleted = 0 ), 0) AS space_use_rate, IFNULL(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(match_rate), 2) FROM fee_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效' ), 0) AS rule_match_rate, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{query.startTime} AND #{query.endTime} ), 0) AS revenue, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ), 0) AS last_year_revenue, IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS last_month_revenue,
-- 同比、环比 ROUND(IF((SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) = 0, 0, ((SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{query.startTime} AND #{query.endTime}) - (SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR))) / (SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) * 100), 2) AS year_on_year,
ROUND(IF((SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = 0, 0, ((SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN #{query.startTime} AND #{query.endTime}) - (SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) / (SELECT SUM(today_income) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{query.startTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(#{query.endTime}, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) * 100), 2) AS month_on_month

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_order_count), 0) AS totalOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_income), 0) AS totalIncome, IFNULL( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM parking_space_info WHERE real_status = '占用' AND deleted = 0) / (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM parking_space_info WHERE deleted = 0) * 100, 0 ) AS totalSpaceUseRate FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN charge_park_link cpl ON s.id = cpl.station_id WHERE s.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cpl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_order_count), 0) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_income), 0) AS income FROM charge_park_link cpl LEFT JOIN station_info s ON s.id = cpl.station_id WHERE cpl.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cpl.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT a.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_income), 0) AS income FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN area_info a ON s.area_id = a.id LEFT JOIN charge_park_link cpl ON s.id = cpl.station_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY income DESC
